verdict.rationale: Context.dev's Extract feature crawls only the "relevant pages" needed to fill a JSON Schema and offers "coverage" controls. Its Answers endpoint researches a question on the live web and returns sourced JSON. Both suggest query-driven, bounded crawling rather than exhaustive crawling. However, nothing documents a crawl that adaptively stops once enough information has been gathered; the standard crawl endpoints use fixed page caps (500 sync, 25,000 async). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a sufficiency-based stopping criterion, details of how the coverage controls decide when to stop, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
